description: Lists the 22 standardized financial concepts this API builds from SEC XBRL (revenue, cost of revenue, gross profit, operating and net income, EPS, assets, liabilities, equity, cash flow, capex, dividends, shares, and more), each with its label, unit, kind (duration flow vs instant balance-sheet snapshot), and the ordered source XBRL tags it is built from. Use to discover valid `concept` values before calling get_metric_history. Read-only reference data; no API key. A concept missing for a given company means the company reports none of its source tags — absence is honest, never approximated.
name: list_financial_concepts
